responsibilities: Turn the questions people bring you into clear, trustworthy answers, delivered in the form and channel they will actually use. Work with stakeholders to see whether the answer was understood, acted on, and changed the decision it was meant to inform.
Build self-serve surfaces and documentation that help teams answer their own questions and act on what they find.
Own and evolve the data layer - dbt models, metrics, and semantic definitions - so that the answers built on it are trustworthy and easy to reach for.
Proactively surface what the data shows - patterns, risks, and opportunities nobody asked about.
Ensure data and metric quality through testing, monitoring, and clear ownership of the datasets you produce.
Bring the analytics perspective into data platform decisions: what data, tools, and capabilities we invest in next - and help build them.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure data and metric quality through testing, monitoring, and clear ownership of the datasets you produce.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals outnumber velocity by well over 2:1 - trustworthiness appears three times plus testing, monitoring, quality and documentation - while 'we move fast' appears only in the company and culture blurbs, never in the responsibilities.
evidence.domain_risk: Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A clinical health-tech platform handling sensitive patient data, with the JD itself naming healthtech as 'a regulated environment handling sensitive data'.
evidence.data_team_maturity: We are a small but growing data team. It is still early enough that everyone contributes across the full scope of the data team's work.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The data function already exists with a Head of Data and a production dbt modelling layer to own and evolve, and is growing toward specialisation - growing rather than being founded.
evidence.jd_authorship: Own and evolve the data layer - dbt models, metrics, and semantic definitions - so that the answers built on it are trustworthy and easy to reach for.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The responsibilities name the specific artefacts owned and describe the working model in unusual detail ('embedded with them rather than behind a request queue'), which no recruiter template produces.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Product deciding what to build next. Clinical ops working out how we serve customers. Commercial and finance running the business.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Product, clinical ops, commercial and finance are given genuinely equal weight, and the JD says the role may later specialise toward either the product or the commercial side.
evidence.autonomy_level: you'll own the data layer that the rest of the company runs on
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns and evolves the data layer, sets the analytics perspective on platform investment, and is 'expected to have a point of view and argue it'.
evidence.ai_role: Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI appears only as a benefits-section flourish about colleagues; no AI tool use or AI-facing data work is asked of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure data and metric quality through testing, monitoring, and clear ownership of the datasets you produce.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and monitoring are framed as an owned responsibility with explicit 'clear ownership of the datasets you produce', not as tool familiarity.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Turn the questions people bring you into clear, trustworthy answers, delivered in the form and channel they will actually use.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trustworthiness is the primary framing of the very first responsibility and recurs in the data-layer bullet - the fear is answers that decision-makers cannot rely on.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Own and evolve the data layer - dbt models, metrics, and semantic definitions
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role builds new self-serve surfaces and helps build new platform capabilities while also evolving an existing production modelling layer.
evidence.language_gate: please make sure to apply with your CV in English
evidence.work_arrangement: This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
evidence.loss_aversion: Own and evolve the data layer - dbt models, metrics, and semantic definitions - so that the answers built on it are trustworthy and easy to reach for - the risk being managed is untrustworthy metrics feeding product, clinical ops, commercial and finance decisions.
